subject: Entitlement mismatch: rollback & fallback plan for Cloudia prelist
messages:
From: Emma Liu <emma@cloudia.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-10T09:12:00Z
Subject: Entitlement mismatch detected during prelist - potential rollback

Hi Dylan / Camila / Karthik,

Quick heads up from our prelist run this morning: we saw a set of SKUs flagged by entitlement that don't match the Cloudia entitlement manifest (attached). This caused ~12% of prelist invites to be blocked in our staging test — we've attached the entitlement-report.csv and a screenshot for visibility.

Impact: if this makes it to production prelist, our gating will drop a significant percentage of expected listings and Cloudia has asked we confirm a fallback approach. They also asked whether Redwood can revert the integration to the previous entitlement mapping as a backup for the scheduled marketplace rollout next week.

Can you advise if a safe rollback is feasible within a 24–48 hour window, and what the operational owner and steps would be? Cloudia is expecting an acceptance/plan by EOD today.

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Liu | Partner Ops, Cloudia Marketplace
Attachments: entitlement-report.csv, prelist-screenshot.png
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma@cloudia.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-10T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Entitlement mismatch detected during prelist - potential rollback

Emma — thanks for the quick report and the CSV.

Short answer: yes, we can support a rollback/fallback path, but we need to align owners, exact rollback artifacts, and an agreed cutover window.

Camila / Karthik Iyer: can you confirm the following by 1pm PT?
- Which deployment holds the current entitlement mapping (hosted vs dedicated) and whether the previous mapping is tagged in config repo.
- Estimated time to revert (code/config + multi-region propagation) and test plan to validate prelist pass after rollback.
- Any DB or downstream cache invalidations we need to run.

Marissa: product question — do we want a temporary SLA exception window for Cloudia during the rollback and retest (they requested a 48h grace). Also, will we require a special feature flag for the previous mapping so we can A/B or ramp?

Ben: heads up — Cloudia will expect a confirmation (and may reference contract SLA language). If we need to offer credits or exec signoff, circle back.

I'll own comms with Emma and Cloudia while we collect the technical inputs.

– Dylan
Dylan Brooks | Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Emma Liu <emma@cloudia.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-10T13:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Entitlement mismatch detected during prelist - potential rollback

On Tue, Jul 10, 2028 at 10:05 AM, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com> wrote:
> Camila / Karthik Iyer: can you confirm the following by 1pm PT?

Thanks — wrote up a short technical runbook. TL;DR: rollback is feasible and low-risk if we follow the checklist below. I've attached rollback-checklist.md.

High level plan (estimate):
- Owner: Camila (infra) + Karthik (SE) for validation
- Prep (30–60m): locate previous entitlement artifact (tag: ent-v1.14), stage config in canary region (us-west-2), snapshot relevant caches
- Cut (15–30m): flip config flag to ent-v1.14 in canary, run quick prelist smoke, promote to remaining regions in 3 waves (15–20m each)
- Post-cut (60m): verify invite acceptance rates, run 2 full prelist cycles and compare against staging baseline

Risks / notes:
- If Cloudia's gating logic relies on downstream enrichment (Cloudia-side mapping), we need a confirmation that their mapping hasn't drifted. Emma — please confirm your mapping version.
- Cache TTLs: we must invalidate a couple of Redis keys (keys listed in rollback-checklist.md). If invalidation isn't completed, propagation will be delayed and the rollback may look partial.

Test matrix (what we'll run post-cut):
- Smoke: 50 synthetic invites across 3 SKUs (low risk)
- Full: 1k invite sample across top 10 SKUs
- Telemetry: realtime event counts + 5-min token-level latency check

If legal/commercial wants a policy-based rollback (i.e., automatic fallback if success rate < 90%), we can wire a temporary policy but that'll require Marissa's sign-off.

Camila
Camila Reyes | Senior Engineering Manager, Integrations
Attachments: rollback-checklist.md
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Liu <emma@cloudia.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-11T08:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Entitlement mismatch detected during prelist - potential rollback

On Tue, Jul 10, 2028 at 1:30 PM, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com> wrote:
> High level plan (estimate): ...

Thanks Camila — this looks good. A couple of product asks and constraints before we confirm dates: 

1) Feature flag approach: we prefer not to do a global config flip without a feature flag that allows canary throttling by partner. Can engineering scope a feature flag toggle that targets partner_id=cloudia for the canary wave? We need that to validate without impacting other partners.

2) SLA exception: Cloudia requested a 48h grace window. Product is OK to grant a temporary SLA exception but needs the following in writing: success criteria for rollback (>=90% invite acceptance on full sample), a scheduled post-mortem within 72h, and an agreed credit policy if acceptance <80%. Ben — can you confirm commercial ok?

3) Rollout timing: we should target Sunday 2028-07-16 02:00–04:00 PT for the rollback to minimize user impact assuming engineering estimates hold. Camila — please confirm if that window works for ops.

If all agree, Dylan please send a one-line confirmation to Cloudia with owners, window, and the acceptance criteria.

Marissa
Marissa Cole | Group Product Manager, Marketplace Integrations
From: Emma Liu <emma@cloudia.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-11T12:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Entitlement mismatch detected during prelist - potential rollback

Thanks team — appreciate the fast turnaround and the clear plan. Confirming Cloudia will: 
- Validate our mapping version and send the mapping file back to Camila by EOD today (we'll attach a mapping manifest).
- Accept the proposed rollback window: Sun 2028-07-16 02:00–04:00 PT, pending final sign-off from your ops.
- Agree to the success criteria: >=90% invite acceptance on full sample. If the acceptance falls below 80%, we'll open the credit conversation per your policy.

Please reply with a one-line official go/no-go once you have ops confirmation and Ben's commercial nod.

Emma
Emma Liu | Partner Ops, Cloudia Marketplace
Attachments: (will send mapping manifest)
